newsitem.title: DUBAI: Quakes hit northwest Iran, no casualty reports yet.
newsitem.headline: Quakes hit northwest Iran, no casualty reports yet.

text.p: Two earthquakes shook the cities of Ardabil and Nir in northwestern Iran late on Sunday, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Monday.
It said the first quake, measuring 3.3 on the Richter scale struck at 7:21 p.m. (1451 GMT). Another quake measuring 4.1 struck at 10:34 p.m. (1804 GMT).
The second's epicentre was 30 km (20 miles) west of Ardabil, where nearly 1,000 people were killed by a quake measuring 5.5 in late February.
"No report has yet been received on possible loss of life or damage to property," IRNA said.
A force four earthquake is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
